Accounts and roles

Summary

Candidates and employers register and sign in; an employer registers together with their company. Every later feature (reviews, profiles, applications) needs to know who the user is and which role they have, so this ships first. Authentication follows ADR-0001: the API issues Sanctum personal access tokens, and the Next.js server keeps them in the HttpOnly hireboard_session cookie.

Context

  • Problem: Hireboard has a public job search (HIRE-1) and no accounts. HIRE-4, HIRE-5 and HIRE-6 are blocked on a user identity and role. The auth approach is decided (ADR-0001, accepted 2026-10-20).
  • User impact: candidates and employers get an account and a dashboard. Guests keep browsing jobs without signing in.

Scope

In scope

  • role column on users (schema doc first), UserRole enum, role helpers on User, factory states.
  • POST /api/v1/auth/register, POST /api/v1/auth/login, POST /api/v1/auth/logout, GET /api/v1/auth/me.
  • Employer registration creates the employer's company (BR-02).
  • Demo accounts in DemoUserSeeder (candidate, employer owning Acme Robotics, admin).
  • Web: /login, /register, /dashboard, the (account) layout with role-based navigation and sign-out, middleware.ts, lib/session.ts.

Out of scope

  • Email verification, password reset, "remember me", social login.
  • Admin user management (admins are seeded only, BR-01).
  • Refresh or sliding token expiry (deferred in ADR-0001).
  • Editing the company created at registration (HIRE-11 area).

Must NOT change

  • MNC-1: GET /api/v1/jobs, GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} and GET /api/v1/companies/{slug} stay public (no token needed) with unchanged response shapes.
  • MNC-2: /jobs renders for guests without a redirect to /login.

Acceptance criteria

  • AC-1: WHEN a visitor registers with role candidate, a name, a valid unused email and a confirmed password of 8+ chars THE SYSTEM SHALL create the user and respond 201 with {user, token} where user.role is candidate.
  • AC-2: WHEN a visitor registers with role employer and a company_name of 2-120 chars THE SYSTEM SHALL create the user and one company owned by them, with slug Str::slug(company_name) and -2, -3 ... appended while the slug is taken (BR-02). IF company_name is missing THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 422.
  • AC-3: IF the requested role is admin (or anything other than candidate/employer) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 422 validation_failed with an error on role and create nothing (BR-01).
  • AC-4: IF the email is already registered, compared case-insensitively, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 422 validation_failed with an error on email (BR-03).
  • AC-5: WHEN a user logs in with a valid email (any case) and password THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with {user, token}; the token is named web and expires after 7 days (BR-04).
  • AC-6: IF the email is unknown or the password is wrong THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 422 with code invalid_credentials and the same message in both cases.
  • AC-7: WHEN a signed-in user logs out THE SYSTEM SHALL revoke the token used for that request, respond 204, and a later GET /api/v1/auth/me with that token SHALL respond 401. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.
  • AC-8: WHEN a signed-in user requests GET /api/v1/auth/me THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with exactly {id, name, email, role}.
  • AC-9: IF more than 6 requests to POST /api/v1/auth/login and POST /api/v1/auth/register combined arrive from one client within a minute THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 429 too_many_requests. Both routes deliberately share one throttle:6,1 bucket per client, so the limit is verified on login.
  • AC-10: WHEN a user signs in on /login THE web app SHALL set the HttpOnly hireboard_session cookie (SameSite=Lax, 7 days) and redirect to /dashboard (or the next path); the token SHALL NOT be readable from browser JavaScript.
  • AC-11: WHEN a guest opens /dashboard THE web app SHALL redirect to /login?next=/dashboard.

Boundaries

  • Always: a Pest feature test per API AC; service-repository + DTOs (INV-02); schema doc before the migration; add the auth routes to api/docs/api/api-contracts.md and web/lib/api/endpoints.ts (INV-06); every web call through lib/api/client.ts.
  • Ask first: any change to existing users columns beyond adding role; a new dependency (Sanctum is already installed by install:api); changing a public endpoint; touching config/sanctum.php.
  • Never: return the token to browser JavaScript or store it in localStorage (INV-05); expose NEXT_PUBLIC_ API URLs; allow admin self-registration; weaken an existing test.

Technical context

  • Related code: app/Http/Controllers/Jobs/* and app/Services/JobPostingService.php (controller → service → repository shape from HIRE-1), app/Repositories/CompanyRepository.php (gains createForOwner with BR-02 slug suffixing), bootstrap/app.php (error envelope incl. 401/429), web/lib/api/client.ts (token option), docs/adr/0001-spa-auth.md.
  • Already implemented: Sanctum (installed by php artisan install:api, personal_access_tokens migration present); CompanyRepository::findBySlug; the 401 and 429 envelopes in bootstrap/app.php; the token option of apiFetch. Missing: HasApiTokens and a role on User, the auth routes, CompanyRepositoryInterface::createForOwner, the auth entries in web/lib/api/endpoints.ts, any web session code.
  • Approach: RegisterController / LoginController / LogoutController / ShowCurrentUserController → AuthService → UserRepositoryInterface (create, verifyCredentials, issueToken, revokeToken) and CompanyRepositoryInterface::createForOwner. Web: loginAction / registerAction call the API, store the token with setSessionToken, and redirect. middleware.ts checks cookie presence; requireUser() checks the token and the role on the server.
  • Repos: backend api/, frontend web/ (workspace ~/work/hireboard).

Decisions

  1. Token lifetime is set per token at creation (createToken('web', ['*'], now()->addDays(7))) rather than in config/sanctum.php, so the rule lives next to the code that issues tokens (ADR-0001).
  2. Logout revokes the token found from the request's bearer value, which keeps Eloquent models out of AuthService.
  3. Invalid credentials are a 422 with a dedicated code, not a 401, so the login form can tell "wrong password" apart from "session expired".

Open questions

  • [x] Q1: Is email verification required before a user can sign in or apply? — Accepted assumption: out of scope for v1. email_verified_at stays unused.
  • [x] Q2: What is the password rule? — Answered (Maya Chen): minimum 8 characters, confirmed. No complexity rules in v1. Folded into AC-1.
  • [x] Q3: How long does a session last, and does logout end all sessions? — Answered: 7 days per ADR-0001 and BR-04; logout revokes only the current token. Folded into AC-5 and AC-7.
  • [x] Q4: Which employer owns the seeded Acme Robotics company? — Answered: employer@acme.test ("Erin Employer"), attached by DemoUserSeeder.

Dependencies

  • Requires: ADR-0001 (accepted), HIRE-1 (companies table and CompanyRepository).
  • Blocks: spec-HIRE-4-company-reviews, spec-HIRE-5-candidate-profiles, spec-HIRE-6-job-applications.
